programme_name: Máster Universitario en Dirección de Empresas Turísticas - especialidad Events Management / Master's Degree in Event Management (MUDE)
institution: CETT Barcelona School of Tourism, Hospitality and Gastronomy - centro adscrito de la Universitat de Barcelona (UB)
discovery_source: Google/WebSearch 'CETT-UB Events Management máster oficial'; verified on cett.es 2026-08-24; RUCT record 3500329 retrieved from educacion.gob.es/ruct 2026-08-24
notes: BEST OVERALL FIT FOUND. OFFICIAL máster universitario awarded by the Universitat de Barcelona. AUTHORITATIVE REGISTRY DATA (RUCT, accessed 2026-08-24): código 3500329, 'Máster Universitario en Dirección de Eventos por la Universidad de Barcelona', Máster RD 822/2021, 'Publicado en B.O.E.', BOE-A-2025-19419 of 01/10/2025, alta inicial 23/09/2025, non-substantial modification 23/06/2026, teaching centre 'Escuela Universitaria de Hostelería y Turismo-CETT', 60 ECTS = 27 obligatorios + 21 optativos + 12 TFM, implanted from 2025/2026. It is therefore a BRAND-NEW degree (first cohort 2025-26). RUCT lists THREE specialisations: (1) Musical, Cultural and Entertainment Events, (2) Sports and Electronic Sports Events, (3) Corporate and Business Events - specialisation (1) is a direct field-S/music-festival track. CONFLICT TO NOTE: cett.es quotes 'RUCT code 08070301', which does not match the degree code 3500329 and is almost certainly the CENTRE code for CETT - trust 3500329 for the degree. 60 ECTS, 1 academic year full-time, starts October 2026, Barcelona (Horta), on-campus OR live-online. LANGUAGE: page states Spanish AND English - CETT markets the Event Management specialisation as taught 100% in English; the two claims are not identical, FLAG CONFLICT and get the official 'idioma de impartición' in wave 2 before relying on English. Content explicitly covers MICE, corporate, sporting, LEISURE and LARGE-FORMAT MUSICAL events - i.e. real live-entertainment/festival coverage. NON-EU SURCHARGE CONFIRMED AND EXPLICIT (2025-26 rates on cett.es): non-EU EUR 10,188.75 + EUR 510 UB fees; EU EUR 9,262.50 + EUR 510 UB fees. That is a genuine ~EUR 926 non-EU differential - one of the few programmes in this field that states one. COMPLEMENTOS DE FORMACIÓN: entrants from outside tourism/business/economics/communication - which includes a SOFTWARE ENGINEERING degree - must take the bridging course 'Fundamentals of Tourism Activity' (6 ECTS) before starting. That is a direct hit on the 300-ECTS/advanced-standing question and it goes the WRONG way (extra credits, not exemption). WAVE-2 TODO: 2027-28 fees, whether the 300-ECTS degree waives the bridging course, scholarships for non-EU.

notes: DISTINCT OFFICIAL CATEGORY - read carefully. This is a MASTER EN ENSENANZAS ARTISTICAS: an official Spanish qualification, MECES level 3 / EQF level 7, with 'academic and professional validity throughout Spanish territory', homologated by the Ministry of Education with a Certificado de Homologacion de Master published in the BOE. It is NOT a master universitario (it is awarded by a higher artistic education centre, not a university) and it will NOT appear in RUCT, which registers university titles - so absence from RUCT here is NOT evidence against officiality. Spanish law treats masteres en ensenanzas artisticas as equivalent to masteres universitarios; PhD access is generally possible but is granted case by case by the doctoral school - VERIFY explicitly before relying on it. UNUSUALLY 120 ECTS over 2 years (most Spanish masters are 60/1yr). Fee EUR 3,900 for a full 60-ECTS enrolment year, stated for 2026/2027, payable in three instalments; 15% discount for Musikene alumni => approx. EUR 7,800 total for the 120 ECTS. Modality: SEMI-PRESENCIAL (blended online + in-person) - a meaningful advantage. LANGUAGE: group classes in SPANISH; individual sessions in a language agreed with the tutor; English recommended for bibliography. Entry: Grado or equivalent higher artistic qualification; explicitly open to non-music graduates (Psychology, Education, Social Work cited) - so a software engineer is plausibly admissible; selection by merit assessment, no entrance exam. Field P/S: music mediation, management and dissemination. Non-EU surcharge: NOT FOUND. 300-ECTS advanced standing: NOT FOUND.
